title: Quentin and the Static
author: Noor Vane
blurb: Wren Dunmore, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
